name: Daniyal
msgs: I read the poem you sent.
I didn't know a stranger could say what I couldn't.
We're not strangers. Our mothers have talked for three weeks.
That's not the same as knowing you.
Then know me slowly. One message a night.
One good one. Same time every night. 8 PM.
closer: The best love stories start slowly, one honest message at a time.
